_comment: Matka Marsiin (games/marsiin): made by tools/three/marsiin-voice.mjs from lib/texts.ts; the Finnish ones are in voice/fi.json.

clips.mm_f_breakfast: Food comes in pouches. Drinks are sipped through a straw so no drops float away. Tortillas are eaten instead of bread, because crumbs would fly into the machines.
clips.mm_f_run: Without weight, bones and muscles get weaker, so astronauts exercise two hours a day. Bungee cords hold the runner on the belt.
clips.mm_t_squat: Do squats on the squat machine.
clips.mm_f_squat: The machine has no weights: its vacuum cylinders push back like a heavy barbell.
clips.mm_f_plants: The plants grow under red and blue light. The roots cannot tell which way is down, so the stems grow towards the light.
clips.mm_f_cdra: The carbon dioxide we breathe out is taken out of the air. Fans keep the air moving: without them it would stay as a cloud in front of your face.
clips.mm_t_call: Send a message home to Earth, Destiny.
clips.mm_f_crystals: Without weight, crystals grow bigger and more even than on Earth. They help to find new medicines.
clips.mm_t_glovebox: Do an experiment in the glovebox, Destiny.
clips.mm_f_glovebox: The glovebox keeps things sealed in, so nothing can float out into the air.
clips.mm_f_water: The machine turns urine and sweat into clean drinking water. Almost all water is used again: on the way to Mars you cannot order more.
clips.mm_f_suits: A spacesuit is like a small spaceship: it has oxygen, heating and cooling. On Earth it weighs over 120 kg.
clips.mm_t_cupola: Look at Mars from the Cupola.
clips.mm_t_earth: Look at Earth from the Cupola.
clips.mm_f_earth: In orbit 400 km up, the Earth turns below you every 90 minutes. Next time it will be only a bright star.
clips.mm_f_food: There is food for the whole trip: with its packing about 2 kg a day for each person.
clips.mm_f_window: Destiny's window is 51 cm wide and so clear that you can take telescope pictures through it.
clips.mm_f_zarya: Zarya was the station's first part in 1998. Things are held with velcro and bungees, or they would float away.
clips.mm_f_radiation: On the way to Mars you get as much radiation as from thousands of X-rays. That is why the ship has a shelter for solar storms.
clips.mm_t_sleep: Go to sleep in your cabin, Harmony.
clips.mm_f_sleep: The sleeping bag is fixed to the wall so the sleeper does not float away. In space there is no up or down, so a wall works as a bed.
clips.mm_t_shelter: Take shelter at the back of Zvezda!.
clips.mm_f_shelter: Well done! Zvezda's thick walls and water tanks shield you from the storm's radiation.
clips.mm_t_leak: Find the air leak and patch it.
clips.mm_f_leak: Patched! On the real station a leak was once found by letting tea leaves float: they drifted towards the hole.
clips.mm_c_0: In space you grow a couple of centimetres taller, as your spine is not pressed together.
clips.mm_c_1: Tears do not run in space: they stay as a ball on your eye.
clips.mm_c_2: In space a flame is round and blue.
clips.mm_c_3: Remember to hold on! If you stop in the middle of a room, you cannot get anywhere.
clips.mm_c_4: Your nose gets stuffy because fluids rise to your head. That is why food tastes of less.
clips.mm_c_5: On Mars you weigh only a third of what you weigh on Earth.
clips.mm_intro: Your ship is built like the International Space Station. The trip to Mars takes 259 days. Move without weight: push yourself forward and grab a handrail.
clips.mm_moottorit: Engines starting! Hold on to a handrail!
clips.mm_suunta_mars: Heading for Mars! The trip takes 259 days. When the engine pushes the ship, loose things drift to the back.
clips.mm_perilla: We are in orbit around Mars, 400 km up! Go to the Cupola and look.
clips.mm_myrsky: A solar storm! Radiation is coming. Take shelter at the back of Zvezda!
clips.mm_vuoto: The air pressure is falling! There is a leak somewhere. Listen to the hiss and find it.
clips.mm_kaikki_tehty: All done! Go to sleep in your cabin in Harmony.
clips.mm_loppu: The journey to Mars worked! 259 days in space. Next: landing on the surface.
